parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ messaging_product: 'whatsapp', to: $json.to, type: 'text', text: { body: $json.text } }) }}

nodes.name: Send WhatsApp message
nodes.notes: Replace YOUR_PHONE_NUMBER_ID and attach a Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <Meta token>), or swap in your own WhatsApp node. A failure here must stop the branch so the event is retried.

nodes.name: Acknowledge event
nodes.notes: Reached only after a successful send (top branch) or for events that need no message (bottom branch). A failed send never reaches here, so the CRM keeps the event PENDING and hands it out again.

nodes.name: Needs a message?
nodes.notes: True -> send then acknowledge. False -> acknowledge only.
